def clean(df):
    # Remove exact duplicate rows
    df = df.drop_duplicates()
    
    # Fix island column - strip whitespace and fix typos
    df['island'] = df['island'].str.strip()
    df['island'] = df['island'].replace({'Torgerson': 'Torgersen', 'Bisco': 'Biscoe'})
    
    # Fix sex column - lowercase
    df['sex'] = df['sex'].str.lower()
    
    # Convert numeric columns from text to numbers
    df['body_mass_g'] = df['body_mass_g'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = df['flipper_length_mm'].astype(float)
    df['year'] = df['year'].astype(int)
    
    return df

def answer(df):
    # Count penguins per island
    counts = df['island'].value_counts().to_dict()
    return counts
